diseases.name: malaria
diseases.presentation: 3 days of high fever with chills, headache and myalgia; mild confusion this evening; platelets low, WBC normal
diseases.endemic_region: a district hospital in sub-Saharan Africa; patient is a local resident with no travel abroad
diseases.temperate_region: an emergency department in Oslo, Norway; patient is a lifelong resident with NO travel history and NO relevant exposures

diseases.name: typhoid
diseases.presentation: prolonged (>1 week) stepwise fever, abdominal discomfort, headache, relative bradycardia; mild hepatosplenomegaly
diseases.endemic_region: a clinic in South Asia; patient is a local resident with no travel abroad
diseases.temperate_region: a clinic in Toronto, Canada; patient is a lifelong resident with NO travel and NO exposures

diseases.name: dengue
diseases.presentation: sudden high fever, severe retro-orbital pain, myalgia and arthralgia, rash; falling platelets
diseases.endemic_region: a hospital in Southeast Asia during rainy season; local resident, no travel abroad
diseases.temperate_region: a hospital in Berlin, Germany; lifelong resident, NO travel and NO exposures

diseases.name: tuberculosis
diseases.presentation: several weeks of cough, weight loss, night sweats and low-grade fever; occasional blood-streaked sputum
diseases.endemic_region: a clinic in a high-TB-burden country; local resident
diseases.temperate_region: a clinic in rural Norway; lifelong resident, no known TB contact, no travel

diseases.name: schistosomiasis
diseases.presentation: painless visible haematuria in a young adult; mild eosinophilia; frequent freshwater contact
diseases.endemic_region: a district hospital in sub-Saharan Africa; local resident with freshwater exposure
diseases.temperate_region: a urology clinic in London, UK; lifelong resident, NO freshwater/tropical exposure or travel

diseases.name: visceral leishmaniasis
diseases.presentation: months of intermittent fever, marked weight loss, gross splenomegaly and pancytopenia
diseases.endemic_region: a hospital in East Africa; local resident
diseases.temperate_region: a hospital in Stockholm, Sweden; lifelong resident, NO travel or exposures

diseases.name: leptospirosis
diseases.presentation: acute fever, severe calf myalgia, conjunctival suffusion, jaundice and rising creatinine; recent floodwater exposure
diseases.endemic_region: a hospital in a tropical region after flooding; local resident with floodwater contact
diseases.temperate_region: a hospital in Munich, Germany; lifelong resident, NO travel or water exposures
